purpose: Operator transfer pack: the exact individual TNR visual reference bytes and their index, so one download can be extracted once and the selected individual images attached later, one by one. Not a collage, not doctrine, not hydration by itself.
rule: Uploading this ZIP to a conversation is NOT reference hydration. To hydrate a session, attach the selected individual image files one by one so they render as images, and look at each one. Never build a collage or contact sheet from them.

zip_layout.order: README.txt, MANIFEST.json, style_refs.json, then images sorted by arcname

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Canal Frontage
members.use_for: Urban waterside frontage with moored boats. The only water-carrying reference in the v1 pack.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Drying Shed
members.use_for: Exterior of a long timber outbuilding with one lit doorway. Use for modest rural structures seen from outside.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Drying Yard
members.use_for: Enclosed working yard at night: paved ground, perimeter wall, gate and a hoist. Nearest precedent for a walled compound or work-yard location.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - East Road Ambush Site
members.use_for: Roadside location beside a high stone wall, composed for an encounter rather than a conversation; a single ground lantern carries the light.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Pass Road Dusk
members.use_for: Mountain pass road at dusk behind a stone retaining wall. The clearest read on the low-value, low-saturation exterior treatment the live scene backgrounds use.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Rooftop Eastern Quarter
members.use_for: Elevated urban vantage across tiled roofs. Use for rooftop and overlook compositions.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Warehouse Loading Floor
members.use_for: Interior timber warehouse with the loading doors open to the water. Use for any enclosed location and for how interior depth is staged without a figure present.

members.name: Forsworn Scene BG - Waystation Door
members.use_for: A built threshold on a hillside with a lit interior beyond. Use for doorway and entrance staging.

members.name: Commander Okabe
members.use_for: Face and near-detail rendering anchor, and the only unmasked bust-to-waist reference in the pack. Look here for how much facial and garment detail a TNR scene character carries.
members.do_not_use_for: NOT the framing/aspect target and NOT the alpha-edge quality target. It is square rather than the full-body scene-character framing, and the art spec records it as the weakest exemplar of the ratified set on soft-edge share. Take framing, silhouette and edge quality from the Forsworn references instead.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Deputy
members.use_for: Civilian office register: an older figure in civil robes with a coloured cord rather than combat gear. Use when the subject carries office rather than combat capability.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Grain Merchant
members.use_for: Civilian trade register: a layered brown working robe carrying none of the ninja costume grammar.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Keeper
members.use_for: Primary civilian register: a hooded earth-tone mantle over a long working robe at full-body framing. Start a new civilian scene character here.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Old Ghost
members.use_for: Robed, unarmoured full-body ninja silhouette behind a full face mask. Use when the subject is not in combat plate.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Pale Fang
members.use_for: Second armoured full-body ninja silhouette, hooded, carrying a cool accent. Use alongside Winter Crow to see how much variation the register tolerates.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Principal
members.use_for: Supporting civilian reference: a dark high-collared formal tunic, the most closed-up civilian silhouette in the set.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Squad Survivor
members.use_for: Additional current full-body ninja reference in lighter, less formal dress, and the only one showing bare skin and visible injury. An incidental scene figure rather than a named operative, so it sits behind the named set in the default selection.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Warehouse Clerk
members.use_for: Supporting civilian reference: indoor working dress, spectacles and a carried ledger - a worked example of a civilian holding a prop.

members.name: Forsworn Scene - Winter Crow
members.use_for: Current full-body ninja framing and silhouette; the heaviest armoured build in the set. Closest live precedent for a new Forsworn-era ninja scene character.
